title: Two balls collide and separate (Physics-IQ)
caption: In the real video the blue ball rolls to the lower left and the yellow ball to the upper right after the collision. The untrained Wan2.2 makes the yellow ball jump to the lower-left corner and back; MoPlan separates the two balls along the real directions.
benchmark_detail: scenario 0031 (balls-collide, left view), best-practice description prompt

first_frame.faithful: byte-identical copy of the generation input
first_frame.source: Physics-IQ switch frame switch-frames/0031_switch-frames_anyFPS_perspective-left_trimmed-balls-collide.jpg, as used by the Physics-IQ Verified evaluation; byte-identical (same sha256) to the file of the same name in the original public Physics-IQ release, gs://physics-iq-benchmark/switch-frames/
first_frame.attribution: Physics-IQ, Copyright 2024 DeepMind Technologies Limited, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); unmodified

protocol.name: physics_iq
protocol.image: the 3840x2160 Physics-IQ switch frame (the original public release file, also used by Physics-IQ Verified), RGB, resized to 448x256 with LANCZOS

sampler.scheduler: UniPCMultistepScheduler of the Wan2.2 pipeline (flow shift 3.0)
sampler.guidance_note: the same scale is used for the high-noise and the low-noise expert

protocol.output: 41 frames written with imageio (libx264, quality 8) at 8 fps (raw), then trimmed to the first 5 s with ffmpeg -t 5 (trimmed); the composite shows the trimmed clip

seed_rule: seed = 42 for every Physics-IQ video (run 1); both models use the same seed; the noise comes from torch.Generator('cuda').manual_seed(seed)

panels.label: Real video

source.public_release_check: sha256 identical to the file in the original public Physics-IQ release

panels.display: the recorded continuation from the switch frame (3.0 s), resampled to 8 fps and scaled to 448x256

panels.label: Wan2.2 (untrained, same seed)
panels.model: untrained Wan2.2-I2V-A14B (Diffusers weights in $WAN_MODEL_DIR), same pipeline without LoRA, adapter or motion condition
panels.prompt: Static locked-off single-shot with fixed frame throughout filmed with constant framerate in real-time. The scene shows a realistic scientific demonstration. The scene only contains the described setup and actions. A light-colored wooden tabletop with two pipes at the edges. The blue and the yellow tennis ball roll out of the pipes and collide with the same speed.
